title: Firmware 4.8.2 Adaptive Polling Workaround
executiveSummary: Qualification failures on the ApexDrive X500 were traced to firmware 4.8.2. Until firmware 4.8.3 ships, support teams should disable adaptive polling as the recommended workaround.
issueContext: Qualification runs on the ApexDrive X500 began failing at the polling stage.
rootCause: Firmware 4.8.2 caused the qualification issue, as confirmed by the engineering team.
decision: Disabling adaptive polling is the recommended workaround for the support teams until firmware 4.8.3 ships.
recommendedAction: Disable adaptive polling in the configuration of affected units. No reflash is needed for units already on 4.8.2. Turn adaptive polling back on once firmware 4.8.3 is installed.
keyFacts:
Affected firmware version: 4.8.2.
Fixed in firmware 4.8.3 (not yet shipped when this was captured).
Workaround: disable adaptive polling.
Units already on 4.8.2 do not need a reflash; changing the configuration is enough.
sourceDescription: Teams group chat between a support engineer, a firmware engineer and the project lead.
tags: firmware 4.8.2, firmware 4.8.3, adaptive polling, qualification, workaround, ApexDrive X500
